title: LiteRT.js browser sweep result (one file per model)
description: Measured browser behavior of one .tflite model across LiteRT.js backends, produced by web/sweep. Browser backend IDs: wasm_xnnpack (WASM CPU/XNNPACK), webgpu_mldrift (WebGPU / ML Drift), webnn (experimental, behind --experimental). Model-level results only: op-level matrix entries are NEVER derived from these records (Phase 6 trap rule) — a fully delegated model does not license per-op verdicts, and a fallback attributes nothing to any specific op. Every record carries its full env block; a record without env is invalid (headless desktop Chromium is not a user's phone — results are only ever presented with their environment).

model_id.description: Catalog id; also this file's basename under the sweep output directory.

source.description: Where the model artifact came from, as given in the catalog manifest: a URL or a path relative to the manifest. Model artifacts are never committed to this repo.

license.description: License of the model artifact (required in the catalog manifest).

input_spec.description: The catalog input_spec used to build fixture inputs: either dimension-x-dtype specs like '1x64:float32' (multiple inputs ';'-separated, dims 'x'-joined, ':dtype' suffix) or the path of an input-fixture JSON file.

notes.description: Free-text notes column from the catalog manifest.

config.description: Sweep configuration echoed into the output (spec 5.1: warmup and N are config, echoed).

tolerance_rel.description: Output-match passes when every element satisfies |out - ref| <= max(tolerance_abs, tolerance_rel * |ref|). Default policy pending owner sign-off (Phase 6 ask); the values used are always echoed here.

input_seed.description: Seed of the deterministic PRNG that generated fixture inputs (unused when input_spec is a fixture file).

results.description: One record per backend attempted, sorted by backend id.

loads.description: The model loaded and compiled for this backend. When false, failure_class and error say why.

runs.description: One inference completed on the fixture input.

failure_class.description: Machine-usable failure class when loads or runs is false. Known classes: init_failed (the LiteRT.js runtime itself failed to load), fetch_failed, parse_error, compile_error, wasm_memory_ceiling, run_error, backend_unavailable, page_crash, timeout. Open set — new classes may appear; consumers must tolerate unknown values.

error.description: Verbatim diagnostic evidence: the error message of a load/run failure, or the reason an output comparison was structurally impossible (tensor count/length mismatch, non-finite values).

full_delegation.description: Whether the whole graph ran on the accelerator (CompiledModel.isFullyAccelerated). null when not applicable: the wasm_xnnpack reference backend, or the model never compiled.

output_match.description: Numerical comparison against the wasm_xnnpack reference outputs on the same fixture input. null for the reference backend itself, when either side did not run, or when outputs contained non-finite values (then failure_class/error explain).

max_abs_diff.description: max |out - ref| across all output elements. null whenever output_match is null.

max_rel_diff.description: max |out - ref| / max(|ref|, 1e-9) across all output elements. null whenever output_match is null.

latency_p50_ms.description: Median of config.timed_runs single-inference wall times (model.run plus output readback to CPU — the end-to-end cost a web app pays) after config.warmup_runs warmups, in milliseconds. null when the model did not run. The ONLY fields exempt from run-to-run determinism are latency values.

delegation_evidence.description: Runtime console warnings/errors captured verbatim during load and run for this backend — the evidence for full_delegation and failure records. May be empty.

provenance.description: example = sweep of the synthetic example fixtures; never mistake for a real model's browser behavior. measured = a real model measured on the recorded env.

env.description: Mandatory on every record: results are only ever presented with the environment that produced them.

jspi.description: Whether the JSPI WASM variant was active (per-op WASM fallback needs JSPI; without it fallback is whole-model).

webgpu_adapter.description: navigator.gpu adapter info; null when WebGPU was unavailable or not queried.

machine_label.description: Owner-chosen label for the measuring machine (results are his-hardware-his-label).
